vote.question: [US-LA - U.S. Senate]: Julia Letlow (R) has received $14,603,419 in career campaign contributions (with $9,140,910 this cycle, alongside $2,948,284 in outside Super PAC support led by Accountability Project Inc)—linked to "Private Equity, Speculative Finance & Real Estate Syndicate". Do you vote to formally rebuke Julia Letlow for prioritizing private donor interests & failing to represent her constituents by upholding her core civic duties?
vote.futarchy_thesis: Elected stewards are entrusted with representing citizens, yet Julia Letlow has amassed $14,603,419 in career contributions (with $9,140,910 this cycle, alongside $2,948,284 in outside Super PAC support led by Accountability Project Inc)—prioritizing private corporate donors over constituent interests. This civic vote allows citizens to formally censure Julia Letlow on the public ledger and direct 100% of the civic action escrow pool to local community restitution.

futarchy_pole_mechanics.leverage_ratio_statement: Every contribution directly empowers community-led funding. Once the campaign pool reaches $10,000, an automatic 60-day countdown begins. When the 60 days expire, all funds go directly to verified local charities or essential community services—zero platform cut.

Verified local recipients: SOUTHEAST LOUISIANA LEGAL SERVICES CORPORATION (US-EIN:720877422); ACADIANA LEGAL SERVICE CORPORATION (US-EIN:720832432); SHREVEPORT LEASED HOUSING CORPORATION (US-EIN:364591709); PROVIDENCE COMMUNITY HOUSING (US-EIN:204627275); HABITAT FOR HUMANITY INTERNATIONAL INC (US-EIN:721208936). Once the pool hits $10,000, a 60-day timer starts. If YES wins, funds go to these charities; if NO wins, funds go to local community commons (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
bounty_if_passed.destination_criteria: All recipient organizations must be active, verified 501(c)(3) public charities registered in US-LA with clean IRS status and direct community impact. trigger_conditions: Condition 1 (Activation): The campaign activates its 60-day countdown timer as soon as total contributions reach $10,000 USD (Base USDC).
Condition 2 (Resolution Period): The community vote runs for exactly 60 days from the moment the $10,000 threshold is reached.

Condition 3 (Payout): If YES receives 60% or more of votes, 100% of the funds are sent to the verified state non-profits; otherwise, 100% is sent to universal community services (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).

bounty_if_no_wins.description: Community Commons for US-LA: If residents decide against the restitution fund, 100% of the funds go directly to essential local community services in US-LA (Volunteer Fire/EMS, Veterans' Care, Food Banks, and Disaster Relief).
